format: Annotated intermediate example using verified named-field compiler syntax
purpose: Show a dedicated sword-slot item, its private visual chain, and its private loot list without distributing native records or assets.

annotations.compiler_boundary: Only the compiler_spec object follows the inspected clones/patches/set/lists shape. This wrapper is explanatory metadata, not an accepted compiler input. The compiler is not included in this public repository.
annotations.donors: Every angle-bracket donor must be resolved from one hash-qualified source database. Follow the same-slot, same-rarity native loot item and its real references. The placeholder strings are deliberately not valid record names.
annotations.paths: The model, bundle and material paths are synthetic. ModelFile targets a qualified .skel with its matching .mesh alongside it, following the inspected native weapon route. No asset or localization payload is supplied. Compile and package a validated resource closure before runtime testing.
annotations.inventory: MaxQuantity 0 and the level override pair follow the inspected repeatable-drop path. BaseWeaponData, UIItemData, WorldItemData and other unchanged fields are inherited from the qualified donor.
annotations.affixes: The example inherits the drop donor's AffixPicker. Verify that it supplies only the intended base group and does not duplicate affixes supplied by the cloned nemesis gear.
annotations.visuals: This minimal example intentionally has no companion spectral model or scabbard. Qualify an appropriate donor and supply those features when required by the intended appearance. Mesh indices 0..0 are placeholders for a one-group asset, not a universal default.
annotations.tiers: One affected upgrade tier is illustrated. In a real spec, preserve the donor's complete tier sequence, reuse unaffected tiers, and clone every affected tier whose ArtOverride must be cleared.
annotations.tags: The single tag placeholder demonstrates one scoped eligibility reference. It is not the complete broad captain-admission tag set.
annotations.weight: The constant weight 1 is illustrative. Its share depends on competing lists, context, state and outer acquisition routes.
annotations.reachability: The private list is deliberately unattached. Generate complete final Combat.PredicateItem.Items and FactionLootEntry.NemesisGearList patches from current source arrays, preserving every foreign member and order. This example alone cannot drop or activate the weapon through native predicates.
annotations.names: Resolve existing owned records to patches on rebuild, compile the complete stack, repair native named-record order, and propagate the actual rename map to exact string consumers.
annotations.validation: Validate source hashes, reference categories, list preservation, resource closure, localization, idempotence and final database reachability. Then record in-game acquisition, equip, upgrade and save/reload results separately.
